verified_metadata.title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
verified_metadata.abstract: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. To reconcile scalability with global structure, we exploit two key properties of the RG: quasi-locality and scale separation. We rigorously show that the RGFM probability flow can be accurately approximated by local velocity fields acting over a spatial range $O(Λ^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ for RG wavenumber scale $Λ$, linear system size $L$, and prescribed error tolerance $\varepsilon$. This property enables local generative modeling with patches of size $O(\ln L)$ and a computational cost that scales nearly linearly with the system volume. We numerically demonstrate that local RGFM reproduces long-range correlations far beyond its receptive field in representative one-dimensional distributions, while conventional local flow matching exhibits substantial errors at long distances. On FFHQ images, RGFM yields far more coherent and higher-quality samples than local flow matching at 64x64 and 256x256. Our results establish RG-guided probability flows as a promising route toward scalable generative modeling that captures long-range structure using only local computation.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: The University of Tokyo：Department of Physics 与 Institute for Physics of Intelligence。

sections.title: 摘要
paragraphs: RGFM 以精确 RG coarse-graining 作为 flow-matching probability path，从长波到短波逐级生成。尺度分离让被积掉的高波数模成为可独立重采样的高斯扇区，准局域性则允许每个尺度用局域速度场反演。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 局域生成模型计算便宜却看不到远距离，全球模型能保持结构却成本高。能否选择一种 probability path，使长程相关由尺度组织而非全局 receptive field 承担？

sections.title: 为什么进入 Daily
paragraphs: 把 RG 流作为 probability path，严格连接局域计算、尺度分离和长程相关，并给出对数 patch 尺度。 本次遴选不是依据标题关键词或摘要热度：先从 2026-08-26 的官方 arXiv 分类清单锁定 v1 候选，再核对全文中的问题定义、方法、关键公式、实验或定理、限制条件和资源声明。该文按统一 40 分量表得到 36/40，达到 Daily 的 S 级门槛；分数只表示本网站本轮的相关性与证据完整度，不替代同行评议。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 作者从 Polchinski 型 RG diffusion 构造概率路径，交替进行局域 reverse ODE 与 site-decimation 的随机 lifting；对局域/条件局域目标证明 score locality、速度逼近误差和 ODE/SDE 稳定界，再以一维多尺度分布和 FFHQ 验证。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: Main Theorems IV.15-IV.20 给出局域误差随 $\exp(-c\Lambda\ell_B)L^\alpha$ 衰减，并推出 $O(\ln L)$ patch。
一维实验显示 RGFM 在 receptive field 外仍恢复长程相关，而普通 local FM 出现显著误差；FFHQ 64×64 下 RGFM 在所有测试 patch 尺度保持更低 FID，256×256 样本全局脸部结构也更连贯，但仍有分离部件不一致。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 严格定理依赖物理型 RG locality、Lipschitz 与稳定性假设；自然图像是否满足同一数学条件没有被证明。实验规模有限，256×256 结果仍有远距离五官不一致，且随机 lifting/decimation 会引入额外设计选择。

sections.title: 证据审计
bullets: 全文核验锚点：paper.pdf pp. 1-4: RGFM construction, informal locality theorem, and stated scaling; paper.pdf pp. 10-18: local approximation definitions and Main Theorems IV.15-IV.20; paper.pdf pp. 19-26: one-dimensional correlation tests and FFHQ comparisons; paper.pdf p. 32: limitations and future directions。卡片中的定量结论只在这些页码和作者声明的设定内复述，未把理论极限、受控数值或小规模实验外推为生产系统结论。
